data.one_liner: Download files (optionally unzip) and store them locally for later use.
data.what_it_does: The package downloads assets from given URLs, can uncompress them using built‑in or custom delegates, and saves them to a configurable directory. It provides callbacks for progress, completion and cancellation, and supports web, mobile and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need to fetch large assets (images, videos, zip bundles) at runtime rather than bundling them with the app
You require custom decompression for formats beyond ZIP
You want a simple API with progress reporting and optional cancellation
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured caching or offline sync solution
You require secure/encrypted storage of sensitive data
You only need basic HTTP GET without file handling
strengths: Built‑in support for ZIP and custom uncompress delegates
weaknesses: Relies on dio; no built‑in retry or cache management
Only handles file download/unzip, not higher‑level asset management
data.setup_notes: Add storage permissions for Android/iOS; initialize with downloadAssetsController.init() before use

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need HTTP requests without the extra asset‑management layer

alternatives.name: archive
alternatives.why_pick_it: For manual archive handling without the download controller

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: To manage app directories directly without the download wrapper
